name: Approval flow
description: Adds the simplest approval chain to an app: submit → approve / reject, with the state kept in a server-side object

zh.name: 审批流
zh.description: 给应用加一条最简单的审批链：提交 → 通过 / 驳回，状态在服务端对象里

agentHints: This app already has the "Approval flow" component installed (tenon.official.approval): the badge in the bottom-right corner lists what is pending, and submit / approve / reject all happen there. **Do not write your own approval state machine**; to route a business record through it, call its submit method. Its data lives in the component’s own key-value space (isolated per app and per component) and survives restarts; call reset to clear it.
